name: netconverter-customer-toolkit
description: Collect network evidence, plan migrations and guide NetConverter jobs.

interface.shortDescription: Network migration planning and evidence review
interface.longDescription: Collection guidance and migration checklists work without a NetConverter account. Hosted MCP workflows require an authorized account and enabled server capabilities. No device deployment is included.
defaultPrompt: Help me plan a firewall migration and identify missing evidence.
Review my NetConverter job evidence and explain unresolved findings.
Guide changes to my migration decisions using the tools available to my account.
